description: Manual review decisions applied by scripts/georgia-sample/resolve-operators.ts. A facility decision assigns one facility (by CMS CCN) to an operator and replaces its review case; when operatorName is given and no rule built that operator, the decision creates it. A chain decision gives a CMS chain with a withheld name a publishable operator name, or merges the chain into another operator. Decisions without a status are approved. Decisions with status 'proposed' await the user and are applied only by 'node scripts/georgia-sample/resolve-operators.ts --include-proposed', which previews counts and writes nothing. To approve one, set status to 'approved', decidedOn to the approval date and approvedBy to 'user'. Add decisions here instead of editing outputs.
